jobs.title: Global Banking & Markets - NFR Vendor Strategic Supplier Management, Analyst - Salt Lake City
jobs.desc:
GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS
 Our core value is building strong relationships with institutional clients, including corporations, financial service providers, and fund managers. We help clients transact in financial products, raise funding, and manage risk. Our dynamic, entrepreneurial teams value collaboration, innovation, and professionals who thrive in fast-paced, changing environments.
 ROLE OVERVIEW
 This role sits within the Non-Financial Risk Vendor Management team, a vendor center of excellence (CoE) within Global Banking & Markets. The Analyst will support the management of critical and strategic supplier relationships through performance monitoring, risk and issue tracking, data analysis, meeting coordination, and stakeholder reporting.
 Working with Strategic Supplier Managers and cross-functional partners, the Analyst will help identify opportunities to improve service, reduce risk, strengthen controls, and capture value from supplier relationships. The role requires attention to detail, sound judgment, strong analytical skills, and an interest in developing commercial and supplier-management expertise.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Support Strategic Supplier Managers in maintaining productive relationships with assigned suppliers and internal business stakeholders.
• Collect, validate, and analyze supplier performance data, including service-level agreements, key performance indicators, risk metrics, and value-creation measures.
• Assist in creation of dashboards, scorecards, meeting materials, and concise updates on supplier performance, risks, issues, and improvement initiatives.
• Coordinate supplier governance meetings, including agendas, materials, minutes, action logs, and follow-up with accountable owners.
• Monitor open supplier issues, control deficiencies, and non-compliance events; support timely escalation, remediation tracking, and closure evidence.
• Support supplier risk mitigation by identifying emerging concerns, coordinating remediation actions, monitoring progress, and escalating issues as appropriate.
• Assist with reviews of contractual commitments and identify potential opportunities for performance improvement, risk reduction, operational efficiency, innovation, and sustainability.
• Collaborate with Procurement, Third-Party Risk Management, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Finance, and business teams to gather information and progress supplier-related actions.
• Identify opportunities to streamline reporting, standardize processes, improve data quality, and automate manual activities.
• Assist with market and supplier research to support benchmarking, sourcing decisions, and assessments of supplier capabilities and competitive alternatives.
• Maintain accurate supplier records and support ad hoc analysis and management reporting.
 REQUIRED SKILLS
• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to organize data, identify trends, and develop practical conclusions.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records across multiple workstreams.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise presentations and reports.
• Effective organization and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and follow through on actions.
• Collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues across functions and levels.
• Curiosity, good judgment, and willingness to learn about supplier management, procurement, risk, and the business

Department : 
 Customized Solutions
 Location : 
 Zurich
 Contract : 
 Internship (fixed-term)
 Duration : 
 6 months

 March & July 2027
 The role 
 Ardian’s dedicated Customized Solutions team based in Zurich develops and creates proposals for bespoke private market investment solutions that precisely fit our clients’ needs. You will support the team in its global fundraising activities from day one and will play a key role in the team, with responsibilities and opportunities including:
• Supporting the creation of tailored private market investment solution proposals (RFI, RFP, presentations) for large institutional investors worldwide
• Transforming complex investment ideas into convincing fundraising content in different private market asset classes including Private Equity, Infrastructure, Credit and Real Estate
• Developing concise marketing material for Ardian’s bespoke investment programs and working on a wide range of solutions for different client segments globally
• Updating the Customized Solutions’ proposal databases and supporting the development of internal tools and processes
• Participation in the team’s discussions and close collaboration with senior professionals in investment and specialist teams across Ardian
• Opportunity to broaden your knowledge of private markets and develop capabilities in a world leading private investment house characterized by a growth-oriented entrepreneurial culture
 As part of an ambitious and dynamic team, our interns have the opportunity to bring in their own initiatives and can take on increasing responsibility throughout their internship.
 Required skills 
• Multi-tasking and organization skills; capable of managing deadlines and working under pressure on multiple tasks simultaneously
• Strong writing skills and ability to transform complex ideas into convincing high-quality content, combined with a high attention to detail
• Ability to work independently and efficiently; eager to learn on-the-job
• Reliable team player with a broad set of qualitative and quantitative skills, as well as strong interpersonal competencies
• Professional demeanor with excellent skills in English (verbal and written) as well as fluent/native in German and/or French; further language skills are an advantage
• Proficient user of MS Office applications (Word, PowerPoint and Excel); VBA skills are a plus
 Profile 
• Penultimate or final-year university student or recent graduate (Master’s or Bachelor’s degree) in Finance, Banking, Business, Economics or related studies with top academic credentials from a leading university
• Relevant internship experience in financial services, consulting or in marketing in comparable industries; prior experience with investment proposal processes (RFIs, RFPs and presentations) is a strong advantage
• Keen interest in private markets, with a basic knowledge of private market investments; previous exposure to fund of funds (primaries, secondaries and co-investments) is a strong advantage
• Eligible to work in Switzerland
 About the Team 
 Ardian has been a leading provider of high-quality tailored investment solutions for private market asset classes for more than 25 years. Ardian’s dedicated Customized Solutions team is based in Zurich and is responsible for the global fundraising and development of bespoke client solutions with a variety of portfolio compositions, investment objectives and targets, including both diversified and focused portfolios.  Leader mondial sur le marché des Green Bonds, l’équipe Sustainable Banking réunit, au sein du département Coverage, des professionnels ayant une expertise sur les enjeux de finance durable . Divisée en plusieurs localisations, l’équipe Sustainable Banking bénéficie d’un rayonnement mondial. Cette équipe se met ainsi au service de tous les métiers de la banque à l’échelle mondiale pour originer et exécuter des opérations de finance durable sur de nombreuses classes d’actifs (bonds, loans, titrisation, etc.).

Vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur une multitude de secteurs et de zones géographiques en étant pleinement associé(e) aux réunions avec les clients et aux réflexions de l’équipe liées au développement durable. • la mise à jour des bases de données,
• la veille de l’actualité couvrant des sujets au cœur de la transition écologique (e.g. l’évolution de la réglementation au niveau européen, la publication de rapports scientifiques sur le climat ou la biodiversité, le suivi des controverses ESG, etc.)

jobs.desc:
A propos de Sienna 
 Sienna est spécialisée dans la conception de solutions d’investissement sur les marchés cotés et privés. La plateforme multi-expertises propose une offre diversifiée couvrant un large spectre de stratégies : actions, obligations, multi-actifs, hybrides et dette privée. 
 S’appuyant sur une gestion active et sélective, elle accompagne les investisseurs institutionnels et les partenaires distributeurs avec des solutions adaptées à leurs besoins, en réponse aux enjeux qui façonnent l’évolution des marchés financiers. Sienna se distingue notamment par son offre de fonds thématiques et par son expertise différenciante dans la démocratisation des actifs privés. 
 Forte de plus de 115 collaborateurs et de 36 milliards d’euros d’encours sous gestion au 30 juin 2026, Sienna se distingue par son exigence opérationnelle et son engagement en faveur d’une finance responsable avec plus de 90 % de ses encours classés article 8 ou article 9 au sens du règlement SFDR.
 A propos de l’expertise en dette privée 
 L’expertise en dette privée de Sienna structure et gère des produits et des solutions d’investissement pour le compte d’investisseurs institutionnels en proposant à ceux-ci des solutions d’investissement innovantes et peu volatiles, principalement en diversification de leur portefeuille obligataire. 
 Ses activités se déclinent sous la forme de fonds, de mandats ou de fonds de fonds.  
 Ses initiatives portent principalement sur le financement d’actifs réels et les prêts directs aux acteurs de l’économie en direction de quatre secteurs d’activités :   
• Le financement direct d’entreprises  
• Le financement de projets d’infrastructures notamment d’énergies renouvelables   
• Le financement du secteur public (collectivités territoriales et établissements publics de santé hors État)  
• Le financement granulaire de PME-ETI innovantes 
Au sein de son département Secteur Public et sous la direction du gérant des fonds, Sienna Private Credit recherche un(e) stagiaire. Les missions seront les suivantes :
• Préparation de dossiers d’analyse crédit portant sur des collectivités territoriales et leurs projets d’investissement, ainsi que sur d’autres entités publiques (hôpitaux, logement social, etc.) ;
• Rédaction de documents de synthèse sur des projets d’investissements ;
• Participation aux relations avec les investisseurs des fonds ;
• Participation à l’élaboration et à la création de nouveaux fonds ;
• Collecte d’informations auprès des collectivités territoriales, veille documentaire et suivi de l’actualité sur les sujets en lien avec les finances publiques locales (réforme fiscale, réforme territoriale, etc.) ; 
Formation : BAC+4/5 en droit public, finance, sciences politiques, idéalement double cursus Sciences Po/École de commerce ou Université et Sciences Po.
 Un étudiant préparant des concours administratifs aura l’occasion d’acquérir de solides bases en finances publiques.
 De bonnes connaissances de l’environnement juridique et financier des collectivités territoriales françaises, ainsi qu’un intérêt pour le service public local enrichiront le stage.
 L’anglais est indispensable (écrit, parlé).
 La maîtrise de SQL, des logiciels tableur, des outils d'IA, ainsi que de FileMaker est un plus.
 Autonomie, curiosité, force de proposition, rigueur, bon contact relationnel, esprit de synthèse, goût de la recherche sont les qualités que nous recherchons en premier lieu. 
Stage de 6 mois à compter du 1er janvier 2027

• Supporting investment activities through financial modeling, valuation, and deal structuring

jobs.title: Investment Banking Off-Cycle Intern
jobs.desc:
About MACA Advisors

MACA Advisors is an investment banking advisory firm serving market leaders and institutional investors across Latin America and the Caribbean, with strong expertise in cross-border M&A and strategic capital raising. We offer senior-led execution, cross-border expertise and rigorous analysis through a lean platform built on client alignment, transparency and trust.

The program

The MACA Off-Cycle Internship is an 8-week educational program, run outside the summer in three windows each year – Winter (1 December – 15 February), Spring (1 March – 15 May) and Fall (1 September – 15 November), with windows open from Winter 2026–27 through Fall 2028 – and exact dates agreed with each participant, for students who want to understand how cross-border M&A advisory works in practice. It is built around a structured curriculum taught by the firm’s bankers, case work modeled on real transactions, and supervised observation of how our team runs mandates. The program is designed to complement your studies, and we work with universities to support academic credit where it is available.

What you will learn

 - Financial modeling and valuation: comparable companies, precedent transactions and DCF, taught in weekly sessions and applied in case exercises

 - How a sell-side, buy-side or capital raise advisory process runs, from preparation to closing

 - Research methods for companies, sectors and comparable transactions using FactSet, Bloomberg, PitchBook and Capital IQ

 - How professional presentations, teasers and memos are structured and written

 - Latin American M&A specifics, including country risk premia, FX considerations and how multiples compare with US and European benchmarks

How the program works

 - A weekly training curriculum led by the firm’s bankers

 - Case projects built on anonymized or past transactions, with written feedback on each

 - Observation of team meetings and selected client calls, followed by debrief sessions on what was decided and why

 - A designated mentor who reviews your work and meets with you each week

 - A final case presentation to the firm’s partners, with a written evaluation at the close of the program

What you bring

 - Current enrollment in an undergraduate or graduate program in finance, economics, business or a related field, continuing through the window you select

 - An exceptional academic record (minimum GPA of 3.7 or equivalent)

 - Working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and of accounting fundamentals

 - Curiosity, care in the details and a willingness to ask questions

 - Fluency in Spanish and English (Portuguese required for Brazil-based participants)

 - Based in a time zone between UTC-3 and UTC-6

Preferred

 - Familiarity with Latin American and Caribbean markets

 - Curiosity about how businesses in different sectors create value – we are a generalist firm

What you take away

 - Practical training in modeling, valuation and transaction process

 - A body of case work you can discuss with confidence

 - A mentor relationship with a working M&A banker

 - A written evaluation and, on request, a reference

 - Participation in the program does not guarantee an offer of employment. Participants who complete it may apply to our Analyst program.

Our process

 - An interview with a partner covering your studies and interests

 - A short case exercise

 - Confirmation with your university of any academic credit or internship agreement

Adams Street Partners (“Adams Street”) is a global private markets investment manager that has nearly $76 billion* in assets under management. The firm is 100% employee-owned, which fosters a positive and unique culture of collaboration, intellectual rigor, integrity, and a commitment to professional development. For the eighth year in a row, Adams Street was named one of Pension & Investments’ Best Places to Work in Money Management in 2025. 
 Employees operate as a single global team, integrating the expertise of the firm’s investment professionals across five strategies: primary investments, secondary investments, growth equity, private credit, and co-investments. Adams Street is considered a private markets pioneer and was inducted into the Private Equity Hall of Fame in 2000.
 The firm was founded more than 50 years ago, and clients include leading public and corporate pension plans, foundations, endowments, insurance companies, registered investment advisors, and high net worth individuals worldwide.
 Adams Street has offices in Abu Dhabi, Austin, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Hong Kong, London, Munich, Menlo Park, New York, Seoul, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo and Toronto.
 * As of June 30, 2026. Adams Street Partners’ methodology to calculate Assets Under Management (AUM) is based on fund net asset value (NAV), plus unfunded commitments, plus leverage, but excluding the effect of subscription lines of credit. The prior AUM methodology was based on investor commitments minus commitments to fully liquidated underlying partnerships. Such change in methodology was effective July 2026; however, for periods shown prior to December 31, 2025, Adams Street continues to use the previous methodology. This updated methodology more closely aligns with (i) the amount of assets managed on behalf of investors and (ii) the amount of capital available to make direct and/or partnership investments. Amounts stated by investment advisers in regulatory filings (“regulatory AUM”) have a prescribed methodology, which may, in some circumstances, differ from the methodology such adviser uses for other purposes, including marketing efforts. Additional information is available upon request. 
 The Opportunity

You will gain exposure across the full breadth of private markets – buyout, growth, and venture, across geographies and sectors – building the judgement and network that define a long-term career as an investor.

jobs.title: Investment Banking Summer Analyst
jobs.desc:
ABOUT MACA ADVISORS

MACA Advisors is an investment banking advisory firm serving market leaders and institutional investors across Latin America and the Caribbean, with strong expertise in cross-border M&A and strategic capital raising. We offer senior-led execution, cross-border expertise and rigorous analysis through a lean platform built on client alignment, transparency and trust.

 


THE PROGRAM

The MACA Summer Analyst program is an educational program held each year from early June to the end of July – June 1 to July 30, 2027, and June 1 to July 28, 2028 – for students who want to understand how cross-border M&A advisory works in practice. It is built around a structured curriculum taught by the firm's bankers, case work modeled on real transactions, and supervised observation of how our team runs mandates. The program is designed to complement your studies, and we work with universities to support academic credit where it is available.

 


WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

 - Financial modeling and valuation: comparable companies, precedent transactions and DCF, taught in weekly sessions and applied in case exercises

 - How a sell-side, buy-side or capital raise advisory process runs, from preparation to closing

 - Research methods for companies, sectors and comparable transactions using FactSet, Bloomberg, PitchBook and Capital IQ

 - How professional presentations, teasers and memos are structured and written

 - Latin American M&A specifics, including country risk premia, FX considerations and how multiples compare with US and European benchmarks

 


HOW THE PROGRAM WORKS

 - A weekly training curriculum led by the firm's bankers

 - Case projects built on anonymized or past transactions, with written feedback on each

 - Observation of team meetings and selected client calls, followed by debrief sessions on what was decided and why

 - A designated mentor who reviews your work and meets with you each week

 - A final case presentation to the firm's partners, with a written evaluation at the close of the program

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Current enrollment in an undergraduate or graduate program in finance, economics, business or a related field, with expected graduation in 2028 (2027 program) or 2029 (2028 program)

 - An exceptional academic record (minimum GPA of 3.7 or equivalent)

 - Working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and of accounting fundamentals

 - Curiosity, care in the details and a willingness to ask questions

 - Fluency in Spanish and English (Portuguese required for Brazil-based participants)

 - Based in a time zone between UTC-3 and UTC-6

 


PREFERRED

 - Familiarity with Latin American and Caribbean markets

 - Curiosity about how businesses in different sectors create value – we are a generalist firm

 


WHAT YOU TAKE AWAY

 - Practical training in modeling, valuation and transaction process

 - A body of case work you can discuss with confidence

 - A mentor relationship with a working M&A banker

 - A written evaluation and, on request, a reference

 - Participation in the program does not guarantee an offer of employment. Participants who complete it may apply to our Analyst program.

 


OUR PROCESS

 - An interview with a partner covering your studies and interests

 - A short case exercise

 - Confirmation with your university of any academic credit or internship agreement

Position Description: Investment Analyst



About Us

Ridgepeak Partners is a private equity firm that partners with founder-operators to build category-leading platforms across durable, essential services industries. Our platforms leverage a high-velocity buy-and-build strategy to drive rapid organic and inorganic growth.



Position Overview

We're hiring an Investment Analyst to serve as a full-cycle deal professional across Ridgepeak's portfolio. Analysts partner with platform leadership and own transactions end to end: from proprietary origination and seller relationship-building through financial modeling, investment memos, offer terms, and diligence to close. Analysts also contribute to sector identification for future platform launches, honing research skills and investment judgment outside of a live deal environment.

This is a high-accountability, high-ownership role for someone who wants exposure to the full deal lifecycle early in their career and is motivated by competitive, measurable results.



Candidate Profile

Our ideal candidate is competitive, resourceful, and comfortable owning outcomes rather than just tasks. Successful candidates may come from backgrounds in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, or other deal-intensive roles, though we hire strong analytical thinkers from any background who can show the same rigor and drive.

Regardless of background, candidates should be comfortable both picking up the phone to build a relationship with a business owner and building a financial model that leadership will rely on for a capital allocation decision. This is a demanding, fast-paced environment; we're looking for people who want ownership early and are willing to earn it.



Responsibilities

Deal Sourcing & Pipeline Development

 - Source acquisition targets through direct, proprietary outreach across Ridgepeak's target industries, building a growing pipeline and direct relationships with business owners and prospective sellers.

Financial Analysis & Modeling

 - Analyze target company financial and operational data and build detailed valuation, structuring, and forecasting models that surface key value drivers and risks.

Investment Memos & Offer Preparation

Due Diligence & Deal Execution

 - Coordinate financial, legal, and operational diligence with counsel, advisors, and internal stakeholders to shepherd transactions from signed LOI through closing.

Market Research

 - Track industry trends and market dynamics across Ridgepeak's target sectors, refine acquisition criteria, and research high-potential markets for future Ridgepeak platforms.
   
   

Qualifications & Personal Attributes

 - Competitive and motivated to win, with a genuine ownership mindset. Takes accountability for outcomes, not just activity.

 - Clear, structured thinker with strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Intellectually curious and analytically rigorous. Comfortable with financial modeling; strong working proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

 - Organized and detail-oriented under pressure, able to manage multiple live opportunities at once.

 La mission couvrira les activités propres à un fonds d’investissement Infrastructure ainsi que des missions spécifiques au Capital Naturel. Cette stratégie vise l’investissement dans des projets de reforestation dont le sous-jacent est la vente de crédits carbone. • Préparation de synthèses de valorisation présentées à l’ensemble de l’équipe
• Participation aux processus de Due Diligence (aspects financiers principalement)
• Suivi de marché des acteurs du marché du carbone
• Participation à l’élaboration de présentation pour le Fundraising
• Utilisation et créations de modèles uniques et propre au financement de projet en capital naturel

• Motivation

• Réactivité
• Esprit d’équipe et grandes qualités de communication

 Le profil

• Une culture du marché du carbone volontaire est appréciée
 Autres informations

• Début : Mars 2027
 Le rôle
 Le stagiaire sera responsabilisé dans l’exécution des actions de développement de la société, dont :
• Etudes d’opportunités d’acquisitions pour la société (« M&A Corpo »)
• Traitement de l’information, analyse et rédaction de mémos pour les comités d’investissement
• Participation aux réflexions des groupes de travail en interne (business model, l’organisation interne, les enjeux stratégiques…)
• Recherche d'informations sur le marché du private equity et analyse d’études de marché sur ce secteur
• Participation à la préparation des séminaires stratégiques et des réunions du Comité Exécutif, notamment en collaboration avec les autres équipes d’Ardian (récolte d’informations sur les transactions, performances, évolutions des actifs)
• Préparation de présentations devant des clients potentiels ou à des conférences sur des sujets variés en rapport avec le secteur du private equity
• Analyse et préparation de présentations sur l’environnement macroéconomique
• Analyse régulière de la concurrence internationale sur le marché du private equity
 Les missions varient en fonction des priorités stratégiques d’Ardian. Au sein d’une équipe de 3 personnes, vous aurez l’occasion de travailler en autonomie sur certains sujets, et d’acquérir une vision transversale du private equity, au sein de l’un des plus importants acteurs du marché. • Très bon niveau d’anglais (écrit et oral)

 Profil

• Une première expérience en finance, dans un département stratégie d’une entreprise, ou un cabinet de conseil est souhaitable

Our entrepreneurial culture, flat structure and embrace of individual differences, allow creative ideas, original concepts, and unique perspectives to drive our business forward — and for careers to take flight.

Our client relationships are built on trust and discretion. As the world’s largest advisory-focused firm, we have exceptional depth of expertise across industry sectors and geographies. We value the rich diversity that comes from blending local perspective with our global network.

 To participate in the day-to-day activities of the investment banking division. Gain broad exposure to different type of clients, transactions and focus on specialist areas.

Investment Banking, Q2 2027 M&A Intern (Frankfurt, Germany)
jobs.desc:
About Alantra 
 Alantra is an independent global financial services firm that provides investment banking and asset management services to midmarket companies, families, and investors. The Group has over 500 professionals in Europe, the U.S., Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. 
 In Investment Banking, Alantra has completed over 1,000 transactions in the last five years. Alantra combines a strong local presence in key financial centers with global sector- and product-specialized teams. 
 In Alternative Asset Management, Alantra offers its clients unique access to a wide range of investment strategies in five highly specialized asset management classes (private equity, active funds, private debt, energy, and venture capital). As of 31 December 2025, assets under management from consolidated businesses stood at c. €2.7bn, while those managed by firms in which the Group holds a strategic stake amounted to c €14.5bn
 Job Description: 
 Job Description 
 Based in Frankfurt, you will work in a highly entrepreneurial and inspiring environment and become an integral part of our Investment Banking team, within Alantra’s Corporate Finance Team.
 The day-to-day tasks will include:
• Execution of active M&A mandates : Preparation of marketing materials, modeling and valuation analysis, data-room management, etc.
• Marketing initiatives: Market analyses of different industry verticals, preparation of market, strategic and industry peer analysis, screening of potential M&A targets/buyers, financial valuations, etc.
 Interns have direct exposure to all seniority levels internally, as well as direct client contact where possible. Alantra gives its Interns significant responsibilities and is committed to their learning experience during their tenure with the firm.
 If performance is outstanding, interns will have the chance to join our Corporate Finance team as analysts at the end of their internship.
 Requirements: 
• Applicants must have a strong interest in investment banking and M&A
• Strong academic background/results and financial knowledge (accounting and company valuation) and understanding of financial statements
• Entrepreneurial spirit with the ability to contribute your own ideas and work autonomously
• Proficiency in the use of Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook
• Capable of working under pressure and in a context of shifting priorities
• Impeccable communication and presentation skills (verbal and written)
• Attention to detail
• Proficiency (both written and spoken) in German and English is a requirement
 Application Details: 
• Start date: Q2 2027
• Duration: 3 months
• Location: Frankfurt, Germany
 Successful candidates will be contacted within two weeks of the application submission.

jobs.desc:
About MACA Advisors

MACA Advisors is an investment banking advisory firm serving market leaders and institutional investors across Latin America and the Caribbean, with strong expertise in cross-border M&A and strategic capital raising. We offer senior-led execution, cross-border expertise and rigorous analysis through a lean platform built on client alignment, transparency and trust.

 

The role

We are looking for Analysts to join our advisory team. The Analyst’s job is to deliver flawless work on everything that leaves the firm (models, presentations, research and memos) and to make our senior bankers faster, more accurate and more credible. You will work on sell-side, buy-side and capital raise advisory mandates across a range of sectors, with real responsibility from your first week and direct contact with the firm’s partners.

 

What you will do

 - Build, audit and refine financial models (DCF, comparable companies, precedent transactions and basic LBO) across multiple live mandates

 - Produce presentations, teasers, CIM sections and research to the firm’s analytical and formatting standards

 - Run deal research on buyers, targets, comparable transactions and sector dynamics using FactSet, Bloomberg, PitchBook and Capital IQ

 - Develop a working command of Latin American M&A, including country risk premia, FX considerations and how multiples compare with US and European benchmarks

 - Send the deal team a short synthesis after every client call you join: what was said, what changed and what comes next

 

What you bring

 - A strong academic record in finance, economics, business or a related field

 - Advanced Excel and a conceptual grasp of valuation: when to use each methodology and what its output tells you

 - Care in building and polishing presentations and written documents

 - Responsiveness as a default, and the habit of raising a problem early rather than working around it

 - Fluency in Spanish and English

 - Based in a time zone between UTC-3 and UTC-6

 

Preferred

 - Internship experience in investment banking, private equity, consulting or a related field

 - Familiarity with Latin American and Caribbean markets

 - Curiosity about how businesses in different sectors create value – we are a generalist firm

 

What we offer

 - Direct work with the firm’s partners on live and cross-border transactions

 - More ownership of the work, earlier, than a larger platform offers

 - A defined path to Senior Analyst after one year of strong performance

 - Transparent compensation with performance-based incentives

 - Remote-first work with close regional integration

 

Our process

 - An in-depth interview with a partner covering your background and experience

 - A technical assessment (modeling test or case)

 - Reference checks, and in some cases a final conversation with a second partner

jobs.desc:
Excited to grow your career? 
 We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!
 Our people make all the difference in our success.
 ------------------------------------------------------ 
 The Client Coverage Delivery analyst position is under the Citigroup wide Client Analytics & Lead Finance Officer team. This team is focused on enhancing the client management dimension across all of Citi and for delivering timely and accurate client financials and providing insight into client segment performance. This role is responsible for defining, building, and distributing client financials to the firms’ stakeholders and will work closely with the business teams and finance partners to create a single truth of client financials across the firm
 The ideal candidate should demonstrate proven ability to work together with multiple stakeholders across Client, Cluster, International and Scorecards team. The candidate must be able to work effectively in a cross-functional environment without close supervision and with colleagues who may not be in the same geographic location.
 Deliverables include, but are not limited to, Cluster performance packs, EMT dashboard, Country visit packs, defining / managing Scorecard metrics, Bi-weekly management updates. The team also works closely with technology on automating BAU requirements through Tableau dashboards
 Responsibilities: 
• Deliver both ongoing and ad hoc analysis including client metrics for quarterly and monthly business reviews to facilitate decision making
• Undertake end-end ownership of infrastructure and reporting. Propose new ways through advanced tools / ideas to reduce production time and enhance analytics
• Provide analytics on scorecards and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• Digitize data in visualization tools to allow self-service of standard financial content Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on topics for definitions of standard client financials
• Work closely with key partners across teams to help navigate client financials system (CIW), giving walkthrough of the analytics shared and supporting any queries on Scorecard client metrics
• Support broader team in preparing presentation for BAU and adhoc review materials
• Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
• Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
• Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
• Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
 Qualifications:
